notes.title: New PLAYISM Title: Giraffe and Annika Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear PLAYISM fans,

We are writing to inform you that today marks the release of our newest title.

Heartfelt 3D Action+Rhythm Action game, Giraffe and Annika.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1122100/Giraffe__Annika/

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r2PcSX7iinw

Set on Spica Island, enjoy the sights and sounds as you embark on a journey packed with 3D platforming action, adventure, and rhythm game boss fights!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/ea5cafad264aac0053fa8150484c26945a023871.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/311fa9b4c2a07e69510dbd7835c3e014fd0335a9.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/44215ecb8f1da94cfd33ee8e8323561db2b65a6f.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/a155b8b4391c3107f29bbf4588b444a20f1eabeb.jpg

Soundtrack also available!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1241210/Giraffe_and_Annika_Original_Sound_Track/

notes.title: Mac Version & WASD controls coming November 7th
notes.notes:
Hi all! 

After the release of The Silver Case on PC, we are excited to announce that the Mac version finally has a release date. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25717321/a4d398d07913796cac2692a56cb499d34382d924.jpg

Mac users will soon be able to join in the dark adventure presented in The Silver Case. The Mac version is scheduled to release this November 7th.

Not only that, but we will be adding WASD support for players on the 7th as well. 

We hope that you keep enjoying The Silver Case!

notes.title: The Silver Case Release Information
notes.notes:
The Silver Case HD Remaster for PC has announced the release date! 
It has been decided to release the game on the same day as the original PS1 version on October 7th. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25717321/a4d398d07913796cac2692a56cb499d34382d924.jpg

Release: October 7th, 2016 (Japan Time)
Price: Regular Edition: $19.99 / Deluxe Edition: $29.99
(Windows Version, Mac Version will be added at a later date)

Deluxe Edition Contents
1. Art Book 
A Full Colour PDF of the illustrations from The Silver Case. This will inlude the new illustrations from Takashi Miyamoto that were drawn for the HD Remaster. 

2. Original Soundtrack 
This will include all the original songs as well as the remixed one by Akira Yamaoka.

3. Digital Comic
Story: Goichi Suda
Art: Syuji Takeya
The comic takes place the day before Chapter #0 Lunatics in the game. 

Physical Version
Also, we are planning to release a Limited Edition Physical version with Limited Run Games which will include physical versions of the Game Disk, OST Disk, Art Book, Comic and Game Manual. 
Please note that these will be shipped in limited quantities. 


After 17 years, Kamui Uehara is about to wake up again!
